item.title: KCM starts sale process and invites expressions of interest for diesel supply to Nchanga
item.description: Konkola Copper Mines Plc started a sale process for its fuel supply contract at the Nchanga mine.
item.content:encoded:
Konkola Copper Mines Plc has started a sale process for the bulk fuel supply contract of the Nchanga mine and smelter in Chingola.

KCM invites expressions of interest from fuel suppliers for the supply of diesel and lubricants to the Nchanga mine for three years. The mine and its contractors use about 4 million litres of diesel a month.

Submissions must reach the KCM procurement office in Chingola by 30 October 2026. KCM said that it will shortlist suppliers in November.
